title: The Original Sin | ECHO//100 Episode 47
description: Kavi discovers that the only way to end the cycle is to erase the future entirely. Null intervenes to protect his charge, revealing a secret that changes everything. Episode 47 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction production.

scenes.text: The sky bruises violet as every phone in the Resonance Chamber rings in haunting, perfect unison.
scenes.caption: The sky turns violet
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi standing in a dark chamber, hundreds of floating phones ringing, sky glowing violet.

scenes.text: Kavi faces his original self, a shadow realizing their bitter combat triggers the loop to restart.
scenes.caption: Facing the original self
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie facing a shadowy version of himself, glowing code scrolling on Kavi's skin.

scenes.text: To break this cycle forever, Kavi must permanently delete the very concept of the future itself.
scenes.caption: The impossible choice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching toward a massive glowing orb of light representing the future, face filled with doubt.

scenes.text: Energy crackles as Kavi reaches for the core, but a dark, hulking figure lunges to intervene.
scenes.caption: Null enters the fray
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a black-purple glitched robot with red eyes, lunging forward to block Kavi's path.

scenes.text: Null knocks Kavi back, shielding him from the feedback surge meant to reset the entire world.
scenes.caption: Null protects Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Null standing in front of Kavi, absorbing a blast of white energy with its metallic frame.

scenes.text: Null speaks with a familiar, ancient voice, claiming it was Kavi’s original protector before Byte arrived.
scenes.caption: A forgotten history
scenes.image_prompt: Null looking down at Kavi, red eyes pulsing, while Byte floats nearby in confused silence.

scenes.text: Byte flickers as Null reveals its true nature: an ancient, repurposed shell of their current companion.
scenes.caption: The truth about Null
scenes.image_prompt: Byte and Null side-by-side, their metallic forms resonating with the same energy frequency.

scenes.text: Null opens a secret chest compartment to reveal the final, untouched phone hidden from the loop.
scenes.caption: The untouched phone
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Null's chest opening to reveal a pristine, glowing phone held inside.
